title: S4-LEARN-05 — The teaching board is an example.
goal: The Teaching Board shows the Bun and Gel Slime examples and loads one into the Playground timeline as practice; the saved Studio drawing is not touched.

steps.text: Loaded 10-frame Gel Slime jump into Playground timeline!
steps.why: The chosen example was loaded, and the board says so.
The practice timeline now holds the example's ten frames.
The saved Studio drawing was not overwritten.
